metadata.question: Was soil moisture higher at the Coastal Sage UCI station in California during January 2013 than during May 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need soil moisture data for a specific location (Coastal Sage UCI station in California) - Two time periods: January 2013 vs May 2013 - Will use SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) or ERA5 soil moisture data - SMAP started in 2015, so need to use alternative: NASA-USDA SMAP Global Soil Moisture or ERA5-Land 2. Location identification: - Coastal Sage UCI station is part of the UCI (University of California, Irvine) flux tower network - Need to find approximate coordinates - likely in Southern California near Irvine - Approximate location: 33.7°N, 117.7°W 3. Data options: - ERA5-Land monthly aggregated: 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR' (available from 1950) - Use volumetric soil water layer 1 (0-7cm) 4. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 reanalysis data - Direct comparison of mean soil moisture values 5. Logic to distinguish: - Valid comparison: both periods have data, compare values - C1: No data for one or both periods - C2: Not applicable (ERA5 has global coverage) - C3: Invalid/null results - A: January > May - B: May >= January ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location - Coastal Sage UCI station const station = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.70, 33.73]); // 2. Define time periods const jan2013Start = '2013-01-01'; const jan2013End = '2013-02-01'; const may2013Start = '2013-05-01'; const may2013End = '2013-06-01'; // 3. Load ERA5-Land soil moisture data const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR'); // 4. Get January 2013 data const jan2013 = era5 .filterDate(jan2013Start, jan2013End) .select('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1'); const jan2013Size = jan2013.size().getInfo(); console.log('January 2013 images found:', jan2013Size); if (jan2013Size === 0) { console.log('No data for January 2013'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get May 2013 data const may2013 = era5 .filterDate(may2013Start, may2013End) .select('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1'); const may2013Size = may2013.size().getInfo(); console.log('May 2013 images found:', may2013Size); if (may2013Size === 0) { console.log('No data for May 2013'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate mean soil moisture for each period const jan2013Mean = jan2013.mean(); const may2013Mean = may2013.mean(); // 7. Extract values at station location const janValue = jan2013Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: station, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1').getInfo(); const mayValue = may2013Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: station, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('volumetric_soil_water_layer_1').getInfo(); // 8. Validate results if (janValue === null || janValue === undefined) { console.log('Invalid January value'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (mayValue === null || mayValue === undefined) { console.log('Invalid May value'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Print results console.log('January 2013 soil moisture (m3/m3):', janValue.toFixed(4)); console.log('May 2013 soil moisture (m3/m3):', mayValue.toFixed(4)); console.log('Difference (Jan - May):', (janValue - mayValue).toFixed(4)); // 10. Final answer if (janValue > mayValue) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
